ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across approximately 75% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels comprising 25% via mottling and circular scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters are distributed non-uniformly, primarily concentrated on the lateral halves of both lobes. The medial area near the peduncle remains a solid low-intensity black block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with low-to-medium pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Dual convex curves for the main lobe bodies, transitioning into a sharp upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular white ring-like pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the mid and outer sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal white linear markings visible on the lower-left lobe quadrant, intersecting the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent orange-to-tan pigmented lesion/scar on the right lobe adjacent to the median notch. Clusters of physical barnacle shells are visible on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive orange/tan coloration patch localized near the central notch area, contrasting sharply with the surrounding black and white pixels.
